_comment: GAMA response backend. See voice/piper_tts.py and core/response_backend.py.
_backend_comment: "gemini_live" (default) = cloud reasoning + cloud voice, full-duplex, exactly as before. "local" = fully offline jarvis-main-style pipeline: local Whisper STT + local GGUF LLM (core/llm_local.py) + local Piper TTS voice (voice/piper_tts.py). No Gemini session is opened at all in "local" mode, even if internet/API key are available.

piper._comment: Any voice name from https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices — auto-downloaded on first use.
piper._model_path_comment: Explicit .onnx path override. Leave blank to auto-resolve/download from 'voice' into models/piper/.

local_llm._comment: Reuses the GGUF model already configured for the local intent judge (config/api_keys.json 'llama_model_path') unless overridden here.
